mistral-ocr-2512.pricingNotes: Mistral OCR is listed at $2 per 1,000 pages. Free credits, discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: project/links/mistral-general-ocr-links.md documents the Mistral OCR API and OCR model cards. AutoShow does not enforce a numeric Mistral OCR file-size or page-count cap from that source.

mistral-ocr-4-0.pricingNotes: Mistral OCR 4 public model-card pricing is $4 per 1,000 pages and $5 per 1,000 annotated pages. AutoShow plain OCR estimates use the non-annotated page rate; annotated mode is not billed because AutoShow does not request document or bbox annotations.
